topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Hey, imagine my surprise when I found out that you, of all people, live right here in the same city! It's like one of those wild twists in a movie, except it's happening to us. I’ve always said the universe has a funny way of connecting people, and here we are. I hope you're as excited as I am to move things from screens to street corners. How about that? We could finally grab that coffee we've been talking about for ages. Or hit up that little indie bookstore you're always raving about. It's a good day, doesn't it feel like it?
